dataset_name: Synthetic Water Production and Sales Dataset

generation_rules.production: Baseline production adjusted using monthly seasonality, six percent annual growth, normally distributed variation and occasional maintenance reductions.
generation_rules.sales: Baseline demand adjusted using monthly seasonality, weekday effects, six percent annual growth, normally distributed variation and occasional exceptional-demand events.
generation_rules.distribution: Synthetic non-sale deliveries generated on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
generation_rules.inventory: Production increases inventory. Sales and distributions decrease inventory. Outgoing quantities cannot make inventory negative.
generation_rules.reproducibility: NumPy random generator initialized with seed 2026.

limitations: The data was not collected from a real water company.
The seasonal assumptions are illustrative and were not estimated from real operational data.
All customer names and telephone numbers are fictional.
The dataset is intended for system demonstration and academic testing.
The data should not be presented as evidence of actual customer demand.
